name: Microsoft Entra SSO
description: Sign in with a Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) account from one organization, alongside plato's own sign-in. The tenant, client id, and secret come from the deployment, not from this page.
author: plato core

buttonLabel.title: Button label
buttonLabel.description: Text on the sign-in button, e.g. "Sign in with UIC". Empty uses "Sign in with Microsoft".

buttonBackground.title: Button background color
buttonBackground.description: Hex color like #001E62. Set with the text color, or leave both empty for the site's button style. The pair needs a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1.

buttonIcon.title: Button icon
buttonIcon.description: A PNG, JPEG, or WebP image as a base64 data URL, at most 20 KB (the panel resizes an upload to 64 x 64). Empty means no icon.
